reading_hypothesis: Make the allocation frontier an owned Table coordinate. The same number is the public length and the next new ID; successful commit increments it exactly once and failure retains it. This removes the metadata continuation from insertion and puts the correspondence between allocation and cardinality in each constructor reconstruction.
distinct_from_02: Change the internal Table representation and remove the transient intent type; allocation is a coordinate rather than a prepared command.
new_invariant: The next field equals reverse Vec length and the size of the exact name-to-ID relation.
fixed_inputs: Every non-main .bend file is copied unchanged from packages/symbols.
